SELECT * FROM ( SELECT Q.*, ROWNUM AS RN FROM ( SELECT M.CO_CD , FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(M.CO_CD) AS CO_NM , M.EXPEND_NO , TO_CHAR(M.EXPEND_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS EXPEND_DT , M.REQ_DEPT_ID , D.DEPT_NM AS REQ_DEPT_NM , M.REQ_ID , U.NAME AS REQ_NM , L.LEVEL_NM AS REQ_JIK , M.PMNT_DIV , (SELECT LISTAGG(C.CODE_NM, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY C.SORT_NO) FROM TB_CM05M01 C WHERE C.CODE_KIND = 'PMNTDIV' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' AND INSTR(',' || M.PMNT_DIV || ',', ',' || C.CODE_ID || ',') > 0 ) AS PMNT_DIV_NM , M.PAY_DUE_DIV , M.PAY_DUE_DT , CASE WHEN M.PAY_DUE_DIV = 'REGULAR' THEN M.PAY_DUE_DT || '일' ELSE M.PAY_DUE_DT END AS PAY_DUE_NM , M.COST_INFO , M.EXPEND_CONTENTS , M.PAY_CLNT_CD , C.CLNT_NM AS PAY_CLNT_NM , M.CURR_CD , FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(M.CURR_CD) AS CURR_CD_NM , M.PAY_AMT , M.VAT_YN , M.ATCH_DOC_DIV , M.ATCH_DOC_ETC , M.EXPEND_STS , CASE M.EXPEND_STS WHEN 'expendSts01' THEN '미결재' WHEN 'expendSts02' THEN '결재진행중' WHEN 'expendSts03' THEN '결재완료' ELSE M.EXPEND_STS END AS EXPEND_STS_NM , M.CREAT_ID , TO_CHAR(M.CREAT_DTTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREAT_DTTM , M.UDT_ID , TO_CHAR(M.UDT_DTTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UDT_DTTM FROM TB_CM25M01 M LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CM04M01 D ON D.DEPT_ID = M.REQ_DEPT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CM06M01 U ON U.CO_CD = M.CO_CD AND U.ID = M.REQ_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CM07M01 L ON L.LEVEL_CD = U.LEVEL_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BM02M01 C ON C.CLNT_CD = M.PAY_CLNT_CD
ORDER BY M.EXPEND_DT DESC, M.EXPEND_NO DESC ) Q WHERE ROWNUM <= ${lastIndex} ) WHERE RN >= ${firstIndex}

SELECT M.CO_CD , M.EXPEND_NO , TO_CHAR(M.EXPEND_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS EXPEND_DT , M.REQ_DEPT_ID , D.DEPT_NM AS REQ_DEPT_NM , M.REQ_ID , U.NAME AS REQ_NM , L.LEVEL_NM AS REQ_JIK , M.PMNT_DIV , M.PAY_DUE_DIV , M.PAY_DUE_DT , M.COST_INFO , M.EXPEND_CONTENTS , M.PAY_CLNT_CD , C.CLNT_NM AS PAY_CLNT_NM , M.CURR_CD , FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(M.CURR_CD) AS CURR_CD_NM , M.PAY_AMT , M.VAT_YN , M.ATCH_DOC_DIV , M.ATCH_DOC_ETC , M.EXPEND_STS FROM TB_CM25M01 M LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CM04M01 D ON D.DEPT_ID = M.REQ_DEPT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CM06M01 U ON U.CO_CD = M.CO_CD AND U.ID = M.REQ_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CM07M01 L ON L.LEVEL_CD = U.LEVEL_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BM02M01 C ON C.CLNT_CD = M.PAY_CLNT_CD WHERE M.CO_CD = #{coCd} AND M.EXPEND_NO = #{expendNo}

SELECT 'EXP' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YY') || '-' || LPAD(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(EXPEND_NO, -5))), 0) + 1, 5, '0') FROM TB_CM25M01 WHERE CO_CD = #{coCd} AND EXPEND_NO LIKE 'EXP' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YY') || '-%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_WB20M03 WHERE CO_CD = #{coCd} AND TODO_NO = #{expendNo} AND TODO_DIV1_CODE_ID = 'TODODIV20' AND TODO_DIV2_CODE_ID = 'TODODIV2202' AND SANCTN_STTUS = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CM25M01 M SET M.EXPEND_STS = ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN W.SANCTN_STTUS = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 'expendSts01' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN W.SANCTN_STTUS = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*) THEN 'expendSts03' ELSE 'expendSts02' END FROM TB_WB20M03 W WHERE W.CO_CD = M.CO_CD AND W.TODO_NO = M.EXPEND_NO AND W.TODO_DIV1_CODE_ID = 'TODODIV20' AND W.TODO_DIV2_CODE_ID = 'TODODIV2202' ) WHERE M.CO_CD = #{coCd} AND M.EXPEND_NO = #{expendNo}
mapper.select: SELECT CO_CD , EXPEND_NO , FILE_KEY , FILE_TRGT_KEY , PAGE_NO , IMAGE_FILE_NAME , IMAGE_FILE_PATH , IMAGE_FILE_SIZE FROM TB_CM25D01 WHERE CO_CD = #{coCd} AND EXPEND_NO = #{expendNo} ORDER BY FILE_KEY, PAGE_NO
